# Chi2 v1 {#sec-chi2_v2}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    \chi^2 = \sum_{i = 1}^r \sum_{j = 1}^c \frac{(O_{ij} - E_{ij})^2}{E_{ij}}
$${#eq-chi2-qualitative}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Chi-square Test for 3x2 Contingency Table"
#| label: fig-chi2-test

# Create a 3x2 contingency table
# Rows: 3 categories (e.g., Treatment A, Treatment B, Control)
# Columns: 2 outcomes (e.g., Success, Failure)
contingency_table <- matrix(c(45, 35,    # Treatment A: 45 successes, 35 failures
                               50, 30,    # Treatment B: 50 successes, 30 failures
                               38, 42),   # Control: 38 successes, 42 failures
                            nrow = 3, ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                            dimnames = list(Treatment = c("Treatment A", "Treatment B", "Control"),
                                          Outcome = c("Success", "Failure")))

print("Contingency Table:")
print(contingency_table)

# Run chi-square test
chi2_result <- chisq.test(contingency_table)
print("\nChi-square Test Result:")
print(chi2_result)

# Extract test statistics
print(paste("Chi-square statistic:", round(chi2_result$statistic, 4)))
print(paste("p-value:", round(chi2_result$p.value, 4)))
print(paste("Degrees of freedom:", chi2_result$parameter))

# Expected frequencies
print("\nExpected Frequencies:")
print(round(chi2_result$expected, 2))

# Interpretation:
# If p-value > 0.05: we fail to reject H0 (no association between variables)
# If p-value < 0.05: we reject H0 (significant association between variables)
```

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Chi-square Visualization: Stacked Barchart"
#| label: fig-chi2-barchart

# Set up 1x2 panel layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Panel 1: Stacked barchart (counts)
barplot(contingency_table,
        main = "Stacked Barchart: Observed Counts",
        xlab = "Outcome",
        ylab = "Frequency",
        col = c("lightblue", "lightcoral", "lightgreen"),
        legend = rownames(contingency_table),
        beside = FALSE,
        border = "black",
        lwd = 1.5)

# Panel 2: Grouped barchart showing proportions
# Calculate proportions within each treatment group
proportions <- sweep(contingency_table, 1, rowSums(contingency_table), FUN = "/")

barplot(t(proportions),
        main = "Grouped Barchart: Proportions by Treatment",
        xlab = "Treatment",
        ylab = "Proportion",
        col = c("steelblue", "coral"),
        legend = colnames(contingency_table),
        beside = TRUE,
        border = "black",
        lwd = 1.5,
        ylim = c(0, 1))

# Reset plot layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
